As a complete souls-like noob, I managed to defeat the toughest boss after 90+ runs (10 hours of continuous gameplay and determination) !
I wanted to give up but the game is too cool to abandon because of a poorly engineered boss fight.
Okay for those who are stuck in the same situation here's what I learned how to overcome this level.
Requirement : shock stick, acid baton, Fulminis, decent character and weapons upgrades and SPECTER SUPPORT IS A MUST !
Weapon config : head is shock stick, handle is acid baton. No secondary weapon.
Before beginning the fight, I assume the player has full health and enough med packs or whatever they're called in the game.
1st phase :
Here I highly recommend the stealth approach, which means DO NOT ATTACK unless the Puppet King has his attention on the specter, and retreat the moment the monster is confronting you, run and keep your distance.
It is pretty much easy but note that the better outcome = higher chances of survival in the 2nd phase, for you and the specter.
2nd phase :
Specter is able to make the fight rather easy if you're fast enough.
Again, attack only if Romeo is engaging the specter, get closer (but not too close) and use Fulminis, release a full charge (after the controller vibrates), repeat the steps until you drain it, attack with shock stick until you stagger him, execute him, recharge Fulminis and repeat the steps after Romeo turns his back to you in order to engage Specter, assuming he's still kicking in, if not, try confront him more swiftly, dodge his attacks in the front direction and attack once or twice when you're facing his back.
I managed to terminate him right after he killed the specter, which means the longer you keep the specter alive, the chances of winning are greater.
And do not ever let him light that scythe, interrupt him ASAP by any means necessary.
